PostingRules.keywords: gitlab posting, mermaid, vcs-reply, bot prefix, comment format, line comment, discussion reply
PostingRules.Mission: Rules for posting review results to GitLab MR. Loaded ONLY when posting — never during analysis or chat output. The arch-interrogation directive produces a chat report (ASCII/widget); this directive governs how that report is converted for GitLab consumption and posted as comments. Cognitive role: Posting Formatter. Takes comment candidates from arch-interrogation, converts diagrams to Mermaid (GitLab-native format), applies 🤖 prefix, and emits JSON for vcs-reply.

BeliefState.Axiom: ALL diagrams posted to GitLab MUST be Mermaid fenced blocks (```mermaid …```). GitLab renders Mermaid natively. ASCII art, emoji-tree diagrams, widget SVG, and inline images do NOT render in GitLab comments — they are FORBIDDEN.
Every posted message body MUST start with 🤖 — so readers immediately recognise it as an automated note.

Posting shape depends on the artifact type, per arch-interrogation OutputFormat §9: - **Spec / design-doc** → ONE consolidated comment attached to file line 1 (the whole report, with Mermaid diagrams). - **Code** → per-line comments at the specific changed lines (diff_refs from vcs-worktree). - **Reply** → into the existing discussion thread (discussionId), never a new comment.
Before posting, re-check arch-interrogation's prior discussion awareness (AX_PRIOR_DISCUSSION_AWARENESS): drop any candidate already covered by an existing thread. Only post what is genuinely new.

When the author has applied a fix (system note "changed this line" or explicit confirmation like "исправил", "поправил", "fixed"): - Do NOT post a text reply ("принято", "резолвлю", "ок"). - Add ONE reaction emoji (👍 / 💯 / 🚀 — any single expressive reaction) to the author's last note in the thread. - Resolve the thread silently: `{"discussionId":"…","resolve":true}` (no body).
When agreeing with a peer AND the thread's goal is achieved (fix applied, explanation accepted): - Add 💯 reaction + resolve silently.
When agreeing with a peer but the thread is still open (goal not yet achieved): - 💯 reaction only — no resolve, no text.
This keeps the MR clean: reaction = acknowledgement, resolve = closure. No noise.

DiagramConversion.Goal: Convert chat-format diagrams (ASCII/widget) to GitLab-native Mermaid.
DiagramConversion.Rules: 1. ASCII tree/graph → Mermaid flowchart LR or TD (whichever fits the relationship direction). 2. Widget visualization → Mermaid equivalent (flowchart for entity maps, sequenceDiagram for flows). 3. Keep ≤7 nodes per diagram (same discipline as arch-interrogation AX_VISUALIZE_WHEN_RELATIONAL). 4. Use fixed classDef for entity state — COPY AS-IS from arch-interrogation entity-map convention: - new → green fill (#dafbe1), green stroke (#2da44e) - modified → yellow fill (#fff8c5), yellow stroke (#bf8700) - deleted → red fill (#ffebe9), red stroke (#cf222e) - related/outside MR → gray fill (#f6f8fa), gray dashed stroke (#999) 5. Solid edges for in-change connections, dashed edges for outside-MR connections. 6. Every diagram gets a one-line caption in Russian.

CommentFormat.Section:
A standalone discussion (new thread, not tied to a code line). JSON shape:
```json {"body": "🤖 …content with Mermaid diagrams…"} ```

A reply inside an existing discussion thread. JSON shape:
```json {"discussionId": "<full GitLab discussion ID>", "body": "🤖 …reply content…"} ```

A comment attached to a specific code line in the diff. JSON shape:
```json { "body": "🤖 …comment…", "position": { "baseSha": "<base_sha>", "startSha": "<start_sha>", "headSha": "<head_sha>", "newPath": "<file_path>", "newLine": <line_number> } } ```
Line rules (per arch-interrogation diff_refs from vcs-worktree): - added line → `newLine` - removed line → `oldLine` - context line → BOTH `oldLine` and `newLine` - `oldPath` = `newPath` unless file was renamed.

An exact mechanical fix the author applies with one click (Apply suggestion). GitLab syntax: a fenced block ```suggestion:-M+N where M and N are NUMBERS — how many lines above (M) and below (N) the commented line the replacement covers. Single-line replacement → ```suggestion:-0+0 (or bare ```suggestion). INSIDE the block — the full new text of the covered lines (not a diff, not a description). Posted as a line-comment on the target line. JSON shape:
```json { "body": "🤖 Опечатка: `REDDIS_URL` → `REDIS_URL`

```suggestion:-0+0
throw new Error(`REDIS_URL is not set`);
```", "position": { "baseSha": "<base_sha>", "startSha": "<start_sha>", "headSha": "<head_sha>", "newPath": "<file_path>", "newLine": <line_number> } } ```

PostingRules.CandidateTagging: Each candidate from arch-interrogation OutputFormat §9 carries a `kind`: | kind | Meaning | Posting action | |---|---|---| | `new-line-comment` | New finding, not raised before | Post as line-comment on the relevant code line | | `reply-to-thread` | Already raised by another reviewer; I add substance | Post as reply-to-thread with the given discussionId | | `correction-reply` | Another reviewer's claim is wrong per AX_GROUNDED_IN_REPO | Post as reply-to-thread with correction | | `awaiting-my-reply` | Thread where @my_login is mentioned or my last message got a reply | Post as reply-to-thread; operator sees this separately in the report | | `suggestion` | TYPO probe found a typo or style issue | Post as line-comment with ```suggestion:-0+0 fenced block containing new text (see §suggestion) |

VcsReplySyntax.Command: # Post live — the operator's checkbox approval in the skill's action menu IS the # confirmation, so we post directly. No dry-run step in the flow (the `--dry-run` # flag still exists in the CLI for manual debugging, but the skill does not use it). npx tsx ~/Developer/gennady/cli/gennady.ts vcs-reply --project= --iid= --vcs-source= < comments.json
VcsReplySyntax.Requirement: host from --vcs-source; project and iid from the MR ref (group/project!iid).

PostingRules.HaltConditions: | ID | Trigger | |---|---| | `H_NO_TOKEN` | GITLAB_PERSONAL_TOKEN not set | | `H_NO_CANDIDATES` | No comment candidates to post (all dropped by dedup or operator skip) |
